purpose: Design contract; does not prescribe app framework, database migration or deployment
invariants: Access is determined by free sample or package entitlement, never by learning_status or mastery_status.
Stage color is independent of progress, and always accompanied by text and status marker.
A viewed card, a corrected answer and an independently correct answer are distinct events.
Submitting a repeated idempotency key does not create another attempt or payment.
Open-response and canvas submissions are not auto-marked correct merely because they were saved.
No live lesson route may represent an outline as authored teaching content.
The sample JSON exposes answer keys only for design review and is not a production API payload.
Legacy research IDs are provenance links, not an automatic learner-progress migration.
Personal notes remain private; any linked workspace data also requires that workspace membership.

initial_product_settings.settings_evidence: Editorial product defaults; not experimentally validated for this app
